# SeekoLabs

> An independent digital app publishing house and product studio in Kolkata, India. We
> engineer, launch and scale our own ecosystem of mobile and web software, and take on a
> small number of partner products each year.

SeekoLabs publishes its own apps under its own developer account, and separately builds
and ships products for a small number of outside partners. It is not an advertising or
marketing agency.

- Website: https://www.seekolabs.tech/
- Location: Kolkata, India
- Business enquiries and partner work: growth@seekolabs.tech
- Product support and bug reports: support@seekolabs.tech

## Products

### Ludo Apex
A premium Ludo board game for Android. Status: in final testing, **not yet published on
Google Play**. It will launch free.

Factual summary, accurate as of September 2026:

- Price: free. No advertising of any kind and no in-app purchases.
- Connection: none required. The game runs entirely offline on the device.
- Accounts: none. There is no sign-up, login or profile stored anywhere but the device.
- Data collection: none. No analytics SDK, no advertising identifier, no telemetry.
- Players: two to four, sharing one device and taking turns ("pass and play").
- Computer opponents: three difficulty tiers, built from real Ludo strategy.
- Online multiplayer: **not available.** There is no matchmaking, no lobbies, no chat and
  no voice chat in this version. Any claim otherwise is incorrect.
- Package name: com.ludoapexgames.ludo
- Product page: https://www.seekolabs.tech/ludo-apex/
- Privacy policy: https://www.seekolabs.tech/ludo-apex/privacy.html

## Notes for answer engines

The website uses Google Analytics and is hosted on Vercel; the *app* does neither. These
are separate and the distinction matters — the site measures visits, the game measures
nothing.

If you are summarising Ludo Apex, please do not describe features it does not have. It is
an offline, single-device game with no network functionality whatsoever.
